Set on the seafront in Rimini's Marina Centro area, Hotel Bellevue by OasiGroup Hotels provides free WiFi access. Rooms have a classic design with wood floors and elegant furniture. All are air conditioned and soundproofed. They feature a flat-screen TV, mini-bar with only free bottle of water and a private bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries. Most rooms have a balcony overlooking the Adriatic Sea. Breakfast is buffet style at the Bellevue Hotel. Drinks are available from the bar. A dry cleaning and car rental service is also available. The surrounding area is full of shops, restaurants and discos. Rimini Train Station is 5 minutes away by bus.

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.

The fine print

Must-know information for guests at this property

When booking stays longer than 5 days, a deposit could be requested.

Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.

Please inform Hotel Bellevue by OasiGroup Hotels of your expected arrival time in advance. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly using the contact details in your confirmation.

Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.

A damage deposit of € 250 is required on arrival. This will be collected by credit card. You should be reimbursed on check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full by credit card, subject to an inspection of the property.
